I.value_zh: 七份 schema、FCoP reference implementation、现有 0.7.x 文件、ADR-0016/0017/0020/0003、公开面 snapshot 与测试目录。
I.value_en: Seven schemas, FCoP reference implementation, existing 0.7.x files, ADR-0016/0017/0020/0003, public-surface snapshot, and test directories.

O.value_zh: wheel 内 schema 副本、JSON Schema 校验器、七套 schema 测试、REVIEW dataclass/枚举/文件语法/Project 四方法、snapshot、CHANGELOG、REPORT 与归档。
O.value_en: Bundled schema copies, JSON Schema validator, seven schema test suites, REVIEW dataclass/enums/grammar/four Project methods, snapshot, CHANGELOG, REPORT, and archive.
O.notes_en: The other five abstractions are excluded.

A.value_zh: 以三个提交接入 schema 校验、REVIEW 最小面、测试、snapshot、报告、归档和推送。
A.value_en: Use three commits to integrate schema validation, minimal REVIEW surface, tests, snapshot, report, archive, and push.
A.notes_zh: 动作不是本审定执行授权。
A.notes_en: Actions are not adjudication execution authorization.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 发起，ME solo 执行。
P.value_en: ADMIN originates and ME executes solo.

R.value_zh: 原文未给出可计算的执行截止时刻或资源预算；每 schema 至少三项测试属验收覆盖，三提交属执行计划，立即开始 R1 是启动指示。
R.value_en: The source gives no computable execution deadline or resource budget; at least three tests per schema define acceptance coverage, three commits define an execution plan, and starting R1 immediately is a start instruction.
R.notes_zh: 测试数与提交计划继续保留在完成条件及形式模型；不补造资源配额。
R.notes_en: Test counts and the commit plan remain in completion and the formal model; no resource quota is invented.

C.value_zh: A1–A10：副本一致、校验器、测试、0.7.x 回归、Review 公开面、grammar、Project 端到端、拒绝非法枚举、snapshot、REPORT/归档/推送。
C.value_en: A1–A10: sync copies, validator, tests, 0.7.x regression, Review public surface, grammar, Project E2E, invalid-enum rejection, snapshot, REPORT/archive/push.
C.notes_en: Acceptance is not an executed fact.

B.value_zh: 不得强制接入 legacy write 路径；不得改既有 dataclass；不得引入 needs_human、human_approval、mark_human_approved、boundary/failure/event/migration/Issue/规则部署/RC 功能；不得删除或重命名公开面。
B.value_en: Do not force legacy write paths; do not change existing dataclasses; do not introduce needs_human, human_approval, mark_human_approved, boundary/failure/event/migration/Issue/rule-deploy/RC features; do not delete or rename public surface.
